description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain with roots going back to White Spot's 1928 origin story, now operating over 70 locations across Canada and Asia. The Richmond location sits on Number 3 Road and offers the chain's signature fresh Canadian beef burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and Kennebec fries. Takeout and delivery are available, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's commercial corridor.
